mapper.select: select id, app_id, open_id, union_id, member_id, create_time, update_time from ums_member_wechat_identity where app_id = #{appId} and open_id = #{openId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ums_member_wechat_identity (app_id, open_id, union_id, member_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{appId}, #{openId}, #{unionId}, #{memberId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
